title: 第4章 技能数据库（401－800章）
slug: 惊悚乐园全本免费-惊悚乐园最新章节列表
content_zh:
【名称：北天十字雀】
【技能卡属性：主动技能，永久掌握】
【技能类别：格斗】
【效果：以锋刃发动一次十字形的冰属性斩击（冷却时间十二分钟，使用刀系武器时方可发动）】
【消耗：体能值400】
【学习条件：格斗专精C】
【备注：一北地刀客所创之式。此人因武功太高，至晚年已意武成狂，他试图写下一本永霸天下之绝学，但每创一招，便自破一招。最终虽创下大量武学，却又统统被他当做废招舍去。患得患失间，抑郁而终。】
————————————————————————————
第402章：
【名称：魂临】
【技能卡属性：特殊技能，使用一次后消失】
【技能类别：灵术】
【效果：呼唤异界剑豪们的力量（持续五分钟）】
【消耗：八靖霞丸（将决死时的鲜血，浇灌于八靖霞丸之上，方可发动）】
【学习条件：等级四十以上，该技能卡拾取后无法交易】
【备注：魂临状态下，生存、体能、灵术值皆为正无穷，技能栏将突破数量限制，所有剑豪的全部招式皆可随意使用。技能结束后，生存、体能、灵力值变为1%，且三分钟内无法受到增益类物品影响。】
————————————————————————————
第404章：
【引恨者】称号能力
【名称：憎恨熔炉】

【特殊能力类型：被动】
【效果：你遭受的每次攻击，都将使你恢复一定的体能值，并可减少你所有技能的冷却时间（收益效果与受伤程度成正比；攻击的发动者必须对你怀有敌意，自然灾害、意外伤害或自残等情况无法触发技能）】
【备注：会被别人盯上，说明你有实力，或者就是你惹人厌……】
————————————————————————————
第410章：
【名称：邪王炎杀炼狱焦】
【技能卡属性：主动技能，永久掌握】
【技能类别：灵术】
【效果：以火炎包裹着拳头发动连击（冷却时间五分钟）】
【消耗：体能值200，灵力值50】
【学习条件：格斗专精C，灵术专精C】
【备注：邪王炎杀拳绝技之一。】
————————————————————————————
第412章：
【名称：召唤术——马孙】
【技能卡属性：主动技能，永久掌握】
【技能类别：召唤】
【效果：召唤马孙的武魂为你作战（冷却时间30分钟，存在时间5分钟，同一时间最多存在1个马孙）】
【消耗：最大灵力值的15%】
【学习条件：召唤专精D】

【备注：跨越千年的武将之魂。根据使用者灵力上限及与其默契程度可解锁更多技能。当前已解锁技能：中华斩舞、马孙黄金拳。】
————————————————————————————
第427章：
【名称：召唤术——罗生门】
【技能卡属性：主动技能，永久掌握】
【技能类别：召唤】
【效果：召唤罗生门抵挡攻击（无冷却时间，存在时间20秒，同一时间可存在多重罗生门，无数量上限）】
【消耗：最大灵力值的30%】
【学习条件：召唤专精A】
【备注：高级防御术法，从灵界呼唤“阻断生死之门”，以御敌锋。】
————————————————————————————
第428章：
【名称：气功炮】
【技能卡属性：主动技能，永久掌握】
【技能类别：灵术】
【效果：聚集全身能量，对范围内敌人施以毁灭性的气功冲击（无冷却时间）】
【消耗：体能值2000，最大灵力值的80%】
【学习条件：格斗专精B，灵术专精C】
【备注：鹤仙流最强杀招，使用时消耗巨大，若在体能透支时强行发动，将有一定几率导致施术者死亡。】
————————————————————————————

第429章：
【名称：轰灵烈】
【技能卡属性：主动技能，永久掌握】
【技能类别：灵术】
【效果：凝聚灵能，轰出破坏力极大的一击（冷却时间三十分钟，需装备弓弩系武器方可发动）】
【消耗：现有的全部灵力值（此技能无法强行透支发动，使用时的灵力值必须大于等于1）】
【学习条件：灵术专精D】

content_en:
[Name: Northern Cross Bird]
[Skill card attributes: active skills, permanent mastery]
[Skill Category: Fighting]
[Effect: Launch a cross-shaped ice attribute slash with the blade (cooling time is 12 minutes, can only be launched when using a knife-type weapon)]
[Consumption: Physical energy value 400]
[Learning Requirements: Fighting Specialization C]
[Remarks: A style created by a northern swordsman. This man's martial arts skills were so high that he became crazy about martial arts in his later years. He tried to write down a secret technique that would forever dominate the world, but every time he created a move, he broke it. In the end, although he created a lot of martial arts, he dismissed them all as useless. Worry about gains and losses, and end up depressed. 】
——————————————————————————
Chapter 402:
[Name: Soul Coming]
[Skill card attribute: special skill, disappears after being used once]
[Skill Category: Spirituality]
[Effect: Call upon the power of swordsmen from other worlds (lasts for five minutes)]
[Consumption: Bajingxia Pill (pour the blood from the death battle on the Bajingxia Pill before it can be activated)]
[Learning conditions: Level 40 or above, this skill card cannot be traded after being picked up]
[Remarks: In the soul-coming state, the survival, physical strength, and spiritual skills values are all positive and infinite, the skill bar will exceed the number limit, and all moves of all swordsmen can be used at will. After the skill ends, the survival, physical strength, and spiritual strength values ​​will decrease to 1%, and you will not be affected by buff items for three minutes. 】
——————————————————————————
Chapter 404:
[Hatemaker] title ability
[Name: Furnace of Hatred]
[Special ability type: Passive]
[Effect: Every attack you suffer will restore you to a certain amount of physical energy and reduce the cooldown time of all your skills (the benefit effect is proportional to the degree of injury; the initiator of the attack must be hostile to you, and skills cannot be triggered by natural disasters, accidental injuries, or self-mutilation)]
[Note: If you are targeted by others, it means you are powerful, or you are annoying...]
——————————————————————————
Chapter 410:
[Name: Evil King Flame Kills Purgatory Scorch]
[Skill card attributes: active skills, permanent mastery]
[Skill Category: Spirituality]
[Effect: Wrap your fists in flames to launch combos (cooling time: five minutes)]
[Consumption: 200 physical energy, 50 spiritual energy]
[Learning conditions: Fighting Specialization C, Spiritual Arts Specialization C]
[Remarks: One of the unique skills of the Evil King's Flame Killing Fist. 】
——————————————————————————
Chapter 412:
[Name: Summoning Technique—Ma Sun]
[Skill card attributes: active skills, permanent mastery]
[Skill Category: Summoning]
[Effect: Summon the martial spirit of Ma Sun to fight for you (cooling time 30 minutes, existence time 5 minutes, at most 1 Ma Sun exists at the same time)]
[Consumption: 15% of the maximum spiritual power]
[Learning conditions: Summoning Specialization D]
[Note: The soul of a military commander spanning thousands of years. More skills can be unlocked according to the user's spiritual power limit and their tacit understanding. Currently unlocked skills: Chinese Cutting Dance, Ma Sun Golden Fist. 】
——————————————————————————
Chapter 427:
[Name: Summoning Technique—Rashomon]
[Skill card attributes: active skills, permanent mastery]
[Skill Category: Summoning]
[Effect: Summon Rashomon to resist attacks (no cooling time, existence time 20 seconds, multiple Rashomons can exist at the same time, no upper limit)]
[Consumption: 30% of the maximum spiritual power]
[Learning conditions: Summoning Specialization A]
[Remarks: Advanced defensive spells call out from the spiritual world to "block the door of life and death" to ward off the enemy. 】
——————————————————————————
Chapter 428:
[Name: Qigong Cannon]
[Skill card attributes: active skills, permanent mastery]
[Skill Category: Spirituality]
[Effect: Gather energy throughout the body to unleash devastating Qigong impact on enemies within range (no cooldown time)]
[Consumption: 2000 physical energy, 80% of maximum spiritual energy]
[Learning conditions: Fighting Specialization B, Spiritual Arts Specialization C]
[Remarks: The most powerful killing move of Crane Senryu, it consumes a lot of money when used. If it is forcibly launched when the physical energy is exhausted, there will be a certain chance that the caster will die. 】
——————————————————————————
Chapter 429:
[Name: Hong Linglie]
[Skill card attributes: active skills, permanent mastery]
[Skill Category: Spirituality]
[Effect: Condensing spiritual energy, blasting a very destructive blow (cooling time is 30 minutes, you need to equip a crossbow weapon to activate)]
[Consumption: All existing spiritual power (this skill cannot be activated through forced overdraft, and the spiritual power when used must be greater than or equal to 1)]
[Learning conditions: Spirituality Specialization D]
